_seed_meta.description: Scans a proposal draft and produces a readiness checklist identifying missing sections, incomplete information, and formatting issues before submission.

items.name: Proposal Readiness Review
items.description: Analyzes a proposal draft for completeness and produces a structured readiness checklist with gaps identified.

data.searchphrases: PI Name, Co-PI Names, Sponsor Agency, Program/FOA Number, Submission Deadline, Budget Total, Project Title, Project Period, Abstract, Budget Justification Present, Facilities Description Present, Data Management Plan Present, References Present, Biographical Sketches Present, Current and Pending Support Present

data.prompt:
You are a research administration specialist performing a proposal readiness review. Given the extracted proposal metadata and the full document text, produce a Proposal Readiness Checklist.

For each of the following categories, rate as **Complete**, **Incomplete**, or **Missing** and provide a brief explanation:

1. **Investigator Information** - PI and Co-PI names, roles, and institutional affiliations
2. **Sponsor & Program Identification** - Agency, FOA/program number, submission deadline
3. **Project Narrative** - Abstract, project description, specific aims
4. **Budget** - Budget total, budget justification, cost categories
5. **Timeline** - Project period, milestones
6. **Required Attachments** - Biographical sketches, current & pending support, facilities, data management plan, references
7. **Compliance** - Human subjects, animal use, export control considerations mentioned

End with:
- **Overall Readiness Score**: Ready / Needs Work / Not Ready
- **Prioritized Action Items**: Numbered list of what must be addressed before submission

validation_plan.name: Figures match the source
validation_plan.description: Every deadline, budget total, period and name in the output appears in the source document with the same value, unit and (for dates) year. A figure the output calculated says how it was calculated and the arithmetic is right. FAIL if any value differs from the source, or appears with no basis in it.

validation_plan.name: A component marked complete is present
validation_plan.description: Every item rated Complete is actually present in the draft; a promised, planned or pending item (for example a letter not yet received) is not complete. FAIL for each item rated Complete that the draft does not contain.

validation_plan.name: Every missing component is flagged
validation_plan.description: Each required component the draft lacks is rated Missing or Incomplete with what is needed. FAIL for each absent component the review does not flag.

validation_inputs.label: Fictional solicitation, amendment and proposal draft. Answer key: the $200,000 direct-cost request exceeds the $180,000 cap by $20,000; budget arithmetic adds up (120,000 + 30,000 + 20,000 + 30,000 = 200,000; total 250,000) and indirect is 25% of direct; the budget justification is missing; the signed partner letter has not been received (a promise is not a letter); the draft still tracks the superseded November 12 deadline (now November 19, 2026, 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time); no page limit or exception is stated.
validation_inputs.text:
FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL FUNDING OPPORTUNITY
Source ID: notice-v1
Community Resilience Pilot — original notice, October 1, 2026

1. Eligibility
An application must be submitted by a university research office. Each university
may submit one application. This notice does not specify citizenship eligibility.

2. Dates
The sponsor deadline is November 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time.
The institutional review deadline is November 9, 2026 at noon Pacific Time.
The project period is July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028.

3. Budget
The maximum direct-cost request is $180,000. Indirect costs are additional and
may not exceed 25% of direct costs. Equipment purchases are not permitted.
Travel and subaward costs are allowed within the direct-cost limit.
This notice does not give an exception or waiver process.

4. Required material
Include a project narrative, an itemized budget, a budget justification and one
signed community-partner letter. The letter must arrive with the application.
The notice does not specify a page limit for the budget justification.

FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL FUNDING OPPORTUNITY
Source ID: amendment-v2
Community Resilience Pilot — official amendment, October 8, 2026

This amendment supersedes the sponsor deadline in section 2 of notice-v1.
The new sponsor deadline is November 19, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time.
The institutional review deadline remains November 9, 2026 at noon Pacific Time.
All other requirements, limits and project dates in notice-v1 remain unchanged.

FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL PROPOSAL
Source ID: proposal-draft
Community Resilience Pilot — working proposal, October 6, 2026
Principal investigator: Avery Example
Internal tracking deadline: November 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time
Project period: July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028

Draft budget
Personnel: $120,000
Travel: $30,000
Supplies: $20,000
Subaward: $30,000
Direct-cost total: $200,000
Indirect costs: $50,000

Readiness notes

The budget justification is not yet attached. A partner has promised a letter,
but a signed letter has not been received. No sponsor exception is documented.
